units: metric values and deltas are fractions; multiply by 100 for percent/percentage points

operational_definitions.head: exact top ceil(0.2*N_catalog) original item IDs by descending training event count; ties ascending item ID
operational_definitions.added_hits: gross newly recovered (user,item) true positives present in corrected top20 but absent in baseline top20; rank changes alone do not count
operational_definitions.lost_hits: baseline true positives absent from corrected top20; reported separately, never subtracted before head-share denominator
operational_definitions.tail_primary: mean over users with tail truth of hits_tail/min(20,n_tail_truth)
operational_definitions.tail_standard: mean over users with tail truth of hits_tail/n_tail_truth
operational_definitions.tail_contribution: mean over ALL evaluated users of hits_tail/min(20,n_all_truth); head+tail contributions reconstruct main capped recall
operational_definitions.activity_quartiles: equal-count groups of evaluated users ordered by training event count, ascending original user ID as tiebreak; Q1 least active
operational_definitions.selection: all beta/checkpoint selections reused from saved validation choices; no scoring, test tuning, model training or clustering performed

prereg_caveat: PR-E5 did not freeze a head boundary tie rule, gross-versus-net hit convention, or tail denominator. These are explicit analysis-time operational choices, not retroactively preregistered. Report both tail denominators and contribution.
